data.title: 紫藤伊莉娜 · 和室榻榻米的驹王制服解衣圣愿
data.description: 日式和室的静谧卧房内，微风拂过纸拉门。伊莉娜身着驹王学园女生制服端坐于榻榻米上，白衬衫纽扣微解，展露出优美光洁的肩颈线条。栗色双马尾搭在身前，少女双手合十紧扣着胸前的纯银十字架项链，脸颊与耳根透着熟透苹果般的红晕，琥珀色的清澈眸子带着羞怯却坚毅的决意，静静迎着前方的目光。
data.location: traditional Japanese bedroom with tatami and sliding doors
data.action: 栗色双马尾搭在身前，少女双手合十紧扣着胸前的纯银十字架项链，脸颊与耳根透着熟透苹果般的红晕
data.lighting: soft diffused amber ambient lantern light casting tender highlights
data.promptProse: Inside a serene tatami room lit softly by a paper lantern beside the shoji screens, Irina sits upright clasping her silver cross pendant against her chest with a shy, resolute gaze and flushed ears.
data.animaCaption: Sitting neatly on the quiet tatami room mats with both hands clasped tightly around her silver cross necklace, she meets the viewer's eyes with an earnest crimson blush as the top buttons of her Kuoh Academy white shirt hang undone beneath her black capelet.
data.nsfwProse: She wears her Kuoh Academy uniform with the white blouse unbuttoned at the collar to show her bare collarbone beneath the black shoulder capelet, magenta pleated skirt, and black thigh-high stockings.
